answer: Bindings are kept in ripple, verified in horizon, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the karst check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 194 aliases cost 289 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
